Product_Details: You can find detailed technical specifications, dimensions, box contents, and warranty information under the 'Product Details & Specs' tab on the product page.
Most electronics on our platform come with a standard 1-year manufacturer warranty. You can also add an extended warranty at checkout.
Stock availability is displayed in real-time on the product page. If an item is out of stock, click 'Notify Me' to get alerted when it's replenished.
Order_Tracking: You can track your order in real-time by going to 'My Orders' -> 'Track Package'. You'll see current courier location and live status updates.
Orders are typically delivered within 2-4 business days. Check your registered SMS or email for your tracking number and courier link.
If your estimated delivery date has passed, please allow an additional 24 hours for transit delays or click 'Live Support' to check with dispatch.
Order_Cancellation: You can cancel your order anytime before it has been shipped by navigating to 'My Orders' -> Select Order -> 'Cancel Order'.
If your order has already been dispatched, you can simply refuse delivery at your doorstep when the courier arrives.
There are no cancellation fees! Any prepaid amount will be refunded back to your source account automatically within 3-5 business days.
Returns: We offer an easy 7-day doorstep return and replacement policy for most items. Go to 'My Orders' -> 'Return / Replace' to initiate a request.
Please ensure the item is unused, in its original packaging with all tags, accessories, and warranty cards intact.
Our courier partner will pick up the return from your delivery address within 24-48 hours after your request is submitted.
Refunds: Refunds are initiated immediately after a return pickup is verified. For UPI/Net Banking, it takes 24-48 hours; for credit/debit cards, 3-5 business days.
For Cash on Delivery (COD) orders, your refund is transferred directly to your added bank account or UPI ID.
You can monitor your refund status anytime under 'My Orders' -> 'Refund Details'.
Payment_Issues: If money was deducted for a failed order, don't worry! Banks automatically reverse the amount back to your account within 3 to 5 business days.
We support Credit/Debit Cards (Visa, MasterCard, RuPay), UPI (Google Pay, PhonePe, Paytm), Net Banking, EMI, and Cash on Delivery (COD).
All transactions are secured with 256-bit bank-grade encryption and 3D Secure verification for complete safety.
Customer_Support: Our customer care team is available 24x7! You can call us toll-free at 1800-200-8899 or email care@ecommerce-store.com.
To connect with a live executive right now, click 'Live Chat with Support' in the sidebar.
You can also raise a support ticket under 'Help Center' -> 'Submit Ticket', and an agent will follow up within 2 hours.
